meta.source: Landing page mock (2026-11-18) + brand manual palette (VicTy Night, Indigo, Electric Violet, Signal Teal, VicTy Light). The manual marks the hex values as an initial direction; revisit when the final logo and mascot exist.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything. A dark navy with a violet undertone (VicTy Night family).

tokens.name: aurora-indigo
tokens.usage: Light behind the top of a page (the hero glow). Decorative only: never text, never a fill under content.

tokens.name: aurora-violet
tokens.usage: Secondary aurora light, same rules as aurora-indigo.

tokens.name: aurora-teal
tokens.usage: At most one touch per screen: the tint of a highlighted step card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels: feature cards, step cards, the example panel, the summary panel.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Things inside a card: instrument rows, the quote box, inputs, table rows on hover.

tokens.name: surface-sheen
tokens.usage: Top-left sheen over a surface (linear gradient to transparent). The only 'glass' effect left.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px border of cards, panels, the nav bar, table separators.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must read as a control: inputs, secondary buttons, chips, hover state of cards.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text (VicTy Light).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy under headings, card descriptions, nav links, labels.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels, divider captions. Below 4.5:1: never for information a person must read.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Indigo as text and marks: the highlighted headline words, links, step numbers, quote marks, focus ring.

tokens.name: primary-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button (VicTy Indigo). Text on it is on-primary.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind primary marks: icon tiles, the 'Built on Solana' badge, current step halo.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Signal Teal: available, valid, done, exposure chips. Semantic only, always with an icon or words.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text and the teal step-card wash.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Limitations and exclusions (the 'Exclude:' chip, no route, partial data).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Invalid or blocked: validation errors, failed operations.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger text.

tokens.name: seg-1
tokens.usage: Composition segment / instrument bar 1 (indigo).

tokens.name: seg-2
tokens.usage: Composition segment / instrument bar 2 (blue).

tokens.name: seg-3
tokens.usage: Composition segment / instrument bar 3 (teal).

tokens.name: seg-4
tokens.usage: Composition segment / instrument bar 4 (violet).

tokens.name: seg-track
tokens.usage: Empty track of the composition bar and progress connectors.

type.note: Manrope = ideas and language. JetBrains Mono = positions and data (percentages, amounts, tickers, mints, step numbers).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Once per page: the hero headline.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Panel titles, the closing call to action, empty states.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a title, in text-muted.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card descriptions, notes, disabled reasons. Never smaller.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows above titles and panel captions.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Big numbers: the composition total, a budget.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Weights, amounts, tickers, mints, step numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on dense cards (instrument rows, table panel).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding; title-to-content gap in a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, the instrument color bar.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, notices, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and instrument rows.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels and the nav bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, status pills, the composition bar.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards: depth comes from surfaces and borders, not drop shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Floating panels only: the hero example panel, side panels, the nav bar.

tokens.name: shadow-primary-glow
tokens.usage: Primary button and the active progress step; nothing else glows.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: 2px ground gap, then 2px primary.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content, centered.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of the page (16px under 560px).

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Height of the nav bar.

tokens.name: summary-width
tokens.usage: Sticky summary column on the composition screen.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Side panel (instrument details).

tokens.name: opacity-aurora
tokens.usage: Peak opacity of the hero glow (radial gradient, no blur filter).

tokens.name: opacity-rejected
tokens.usage: A rejected asset card, except its Undo control.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: Every transition.

tokens.name: duration
tokens.usage: Hover and focus.

tokens.name: duration-enter
tokens.usage: The single fade-in of cards.
